Name: Jade Mayonnaise
Author: sunsetsodas
Description:
This is a joke mod I made to bully my mom (affectionately), since she can't see the screen very well and kept trying to add the Jade she'd pick up from our Crystalariums to the Mayonnaise Machine. Now it works! [size=1][Not included: Sap Mayonnaise, for the same reasons. Maybe in the future... ;)][/size]

This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] by spacechase0 to add the new product, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] by Digus to let machines produce it, and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7304]Custom Gift Dialogue Utility[/url] by PurrplingCat and Lemurkat to add some fun responses when you give it to people. Most NPCs won't like it very much, but one character has a... [i]special[/i] reaction. I'll leave you to find out who it is! [s](Or you could look in the mod files, but, y'know, let me have my fun.)[/s]

This mod requires [b]all three mods mentioned above[/b] to work, plus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]. It shouldn't conflict with anything, but let me know if it does and I'll try my best to fix it. Here's some installation instructions, for those who may need them:

[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of SMAPI from the link above.
[*]Download Json Assets, the Producer Framework Mod, the Custom Gift Dialogue Utility, and Content Patcher from the links above.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it and all the required framework mods into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Thank you for checking out my silly little mod, have a great day! <3
